paper_title: Probing MeV to 90 GeV axion-like particles with LEP and LHC
suggested_experiment_name: LEP Z to 2-3 gamma (ALP hypercharge coupling)
notes: Paper sets new LEP limits on ALP-photon (g_agamma) and ALP-hypercharge (g_aBB) couplings from Z->2gamma and Z->3gamma decays, plus LHC and FCC-ee projections. The limits are presented only as exclusion plots (Fig. 4) with no numerical tabulated coupling-vs-mass values; Table 1 gives signal/background rates for a fixed g=1e-4 GeV^-1, not exclusion limits. No extractable (mass, coupling) data points are available from the text. Mass range MeV to ~90 GeV. Coupling type is AxionPhoton (g_agamma in GeV^-1), though paper also discusses hypercharge coupling g_aBB. | Vision: Figure 4(a) left panel shows limits on ALP coupling to two hypercharge bosons. The new LEP result (paper's main contribution) is the green region spanning MeV to ~90 GeV (log10 m_a ~ 6 to 10.7 eV). The plot is a compilation with multiple overlapping regions (LSW, CAST, SN1987a, beam dump, etc.); the green LEP region's lower boundary is traced here. Y-axis is log10(g_agamma) [GeV^-1]; the green region's lower edge sits around 10^-2 to 10^-4 GeV^-1. Coordinates are approximate due to the schematic/compilation nature of the plot. The dashed boundary is Z->2gamma, solid is Z->3gamma. | Calibration: No calibration needed
